checks.label: At 250 mm, 1000 ÷ 250 = 4 pieces fit, the copies end at 1000 mm, the other three are 250 mm and fit 4 times: 1/4 of the metre
At 200 mm, 5 pieces fit and the copies stop at 800 mm, short of the metre; the other three are 267 mm and 3.75 of them fit: 1/5 of the metre
At 100 mm, 10 pieces fit (1/10 of the metre) and the copies reach only 400 mm; the other three are 300 mm, four of which would be 1200 mm, past the end, and 3.33 fit
At 400 mm only 2.5 pieces fit, so the copies run on to 1600 mm and the piece is not one piece of any equal cut; the other three are 200 mm, honest fifths

The bottom number says how many pieces of this size make up the whole: the label reads one over that count exactly when a whole number of pieces of the first piece's size make the metre, and the four pieces on the bar always add up to the whole metre
